targetOwner: NONE_WITH_REASON: Refinery's RefineryPacket type has no top-level content_hash field, and no CVF module owns a canonical Refinery-to-Kernel packet-binding hash contract; Kernel's RefineryPacketRef.content_hash and EvaluateInput.packetHash both require a binding-identity value that Refinery itself does not produce
missingEdge: The accepted T2 contract chain binds Kernel admission to a Refinery-produced packet via content_hash equality (RefineryPacketRef.content_hash == EvaluateInput.packetHash), but neither Refinery nor Kernel owns the canonical algorithm for deriving that hash from a RefineryPacket. SOT3-T6's integration package added a local `packetContentHash()` helper (canonical-JSON SHA-256 over stable RefineryPacket fields) strictly as caller-side type-mapping to satisfy this binding inside one bounded integration slice; it is not a shared, owner-level contract that other future callers can rely on.

citations.lineOrSection: Findings / Position; Dependency-Closure Matrix row `packet binding`
citations.evidenceRole: reviewer finding that the T6 local hash helper is adequate for the bounded slice but does not create an owner-level Refinery-to-Kernel hash contract, and that T7 must reconcile the GAP
caller-side, integration-local type-mapping helper; not exported by cvf-refinery or cvf-truth-kernel
confirms content_hash is a Kernel-side input field with no producing algorithm owned by Refinery

impact: Any future caller that needs to bind a RefineryPacket to a Kernel evaluation request must independently invent or copy a packet-hash derivation, risking divergent, non-interoperable hash algorithms across future integration slices. Does not block the accepted T3 Refinery, T4/T4R1 Truth Kernel, T5 Truth Flow, or T6 vertical-slice acceptances, all of which remain valid within their own bounded scope.

closeCondition.conditionText: A source-verified future tranche is authorized, defines a canonical Refinery-to-Kernel packet-binding hash contract (algorithm, owning package or shared contract module, and field-stability rules), and a reviewer accepts a completion review naming its owner path.

reopenCondition.conditionText: Operator authorizes a fresh packet-binding-hash contract roadmap/work order citing this GAP and the T6 completion review as its basis. Do not implement this contract as an unplanned side effect of an unrelated tranche.
